text:
maya (PM): Quick huddle: need a concrete decision on retirement economics and pin exceptions by EOD. Customers keep asking for clearer timelines.

igor (Eng): Agreed. What's the migration cadence? Can infra support fast canaries?

maya (PM): Proposal: phased over 8w — canary 2w, cohort A 3w, cohort B 3w. Staggered to allow rollbacks per cohort.

nora (ML): Bench gates required before canary. Suggest: quality regression <1.5% on standard eval suite OR no spike in hallucination alerts; embedding cosine drift <0.02 on sampled tenants.

kevin (Support): Need a clear pin policy for enterprise: default soft-pin TTL 30d during migration; customers can request 90d paid pin via contract.

tara (EM): Add that exceptions require PM sign-off. Also surface cost impact for paid pins in sales docs.

igor (Eng): Capacity note: Dedicated pools handle ~250k tokens/day for new model variant without SLO impact. If many pins, we fallback to quantized variant and route traffic.

nora (ML): Define automated fallback trigger: route to quantized model when p95 >300ms sustained for 5m. Also alert ML/product.

igor (Eng): We'll implement a runtime policy like:
```json
{ "trigger": "p95_latency>300ms", "window": "5m", "fallback": "model-quant-v1", "notify": "#product" }
```

maya (PM): Launch gates checklist: bench pass (latency/cost/quality), canary healthy >48h, no customer-critical regressions for 7d.

nora (ML): Bench pass targets: p95 gen latency <250ms on baseline HW, token cost delta <=+12%, rerank top-1 change <=0.5%.

kevin (Support): Support signal: monitor triaged tickets per 10k calls; if >5x baseline over 24h -> trigger rollback. Include CS contact list.

maya (PM): Comms plan: 14d early notice to pin-eligible customers, soft opt-in window with migration credits, mandatory cutover only after 30d unless they opt for extension.

igor (Eng): Internal rollout needs per-tenant migration toggle and metric gates. Ops-bot, create dashboard template for the KPI set.

ops-bot: Dashboard template created: metrics = p95_latency, avg_token_cost, eval_quality_score, ticket_rate. URL: https://console.redwood.internal/d/retire-runway

nora (ML): Also require embedding schema compatibility check: if dims or dtype change, enforce adapter/shim before enabling new version for tenants with saved pipelines.

maya (PM): Add compatibility shim as a blocker for those customers. Update onboarding docs.

kevin (Support): We'll draft migration FAQ + rollback runbook; aim to share tomorrow morning for review.

tara (EM): Action items:
- maya: finalize comm language and TTL policy (today)
- igor: implement fallback policy + per-tenant toggle (sprint)
- nora: publish benchmark suite and thresholds (48h)
- kevin: draft customer FAQ and support runbook (tomorrow)
- ops-bot: wire dashboard alerts to #product and PagerDuty

maya (PM): If no objections we'll start canary with cohort-0 on Monday. :thumbsup:

igor (Eng): Infra no objections.

nora (ML): ML good.

kevin (Support): Support OK.

maya (PM): Closing thread, logging decisions into catalog lifecycle doc and tagging impacted customers.

ops-bot: Saved note to catalog-lifecycle notebook: 2026-03-23T15:26:00Z.
